### Manual. Bolt-on. AI Native.

#### Manual
 People on phones and keyboards doing the books, the leads, the customer questions, and the marketing by hand.

#### Bolt-on
 A chatbot here, an AI dialer there, an AI feature inside the accounting software. Twelve logins. Nobody accountable.

#### AI Native
 A complete AI workforce for every worker in every department — designed, installed, trained, and managed by one firm.

 Our own agent 

### Talk to the agent we use ourselves.

 This is the AI Native service agent — the same Customer Service agent we install for clients, working for AI Native. It answers questions about the firm, books the Evaluation, and says what it is in its first sentence.

- Ask it what we would install for your kind of business.

- Ask it the questions on this page, or the ones that are not.

- Type person and it hands you to one — that is how ours work.

### Your AI workforce.

 A Chief of Staff agent for every worker, and an agent for every function that runs by hand today.

 Department The manual work The agent that takes it 
 Every desk Email, scheduling, meeting notes, follow-ups, status Chief of Staff agent 
 Sales Speed-to-lead, prospecting, quotes, follow-up, CRM hygiene Sales agent

 What each agent does, and how it works with your people 

### Agents need tools. We bring them.

 An agent can only answer chat if your site has chat, keep the books if there is a bookkeeping system, book a visit if there is a calendar. Most small businesses are missing a few. That is normal — and it is part of the Install.

#### The tools you keep
 If you like your CRM, your phones, your store, they stay. The agents are tied into what you already use.

- Your CRM

- Your phone system

- Your store

- Your accounting

#### The tools we bring
 Where a tool is missing, we bring the best one for the job, ready for agents — licensed on your behalf, set up by us, and taught to your team.

- Website chat

- A scheduling calendar

- A bookkeeping system

- A customer-service inbox

#### The tools we make
 When nothing on the market fits, AI Native provides its own application or builds one for you. Same plan, same price, same firm.

- An AI Native application

- A custom application

 Decided in the Evaluation, priced in the plan, set up and trained by us. Nothing is added that the work does not need — and you never learn a tool alone.

### How it works.

- 1 
#### Evaluate
 We meet with you and your leadership and map every department's manual work.

- 2 
#### Install
 First the tools, then the agents. We set up what you keep, bring what is missing, configure the workforce, and train your staff to run it.

- 3 
#### Manage
 We run it, update it, and support adoption over time.

- 4 
#### Report
 You see additional work completed, hours returned, and how the business performs.

 Nothing is installed until your staff can run it.

 The four stages in detail 

### Work you could never staff.

- Website chat that answers around the clock and writes the CRM

- Every call answered and booked, 24/7

- Every lead answered in minutes

- Every quote and estimate followed up

- Every account contacted for reorder

- Every dormant customer reactivated

 Examples, not the list — the work that never got done because it needed a person you could not afford.

### Is this for a business like ours?
 Yes. If you have a phone, an inbox, and books, you have manual work — and the Evaluation begins with your business exactly as it is.

- A solo operator gets the first staff they have ever had.

- A 300-person distributor gets an agent in every department.

- A practice that also sells products, a supplier that also installs — the Evaluation maps all of it.

- A senior leader who has run a business like yours leads your Evaluation.

### Operators, not vendors.

 AI Native is led by a senior leadership team that has built and run businesses together for 35 years — every kind we serve, from a one-person operation to a company of five hundred. They have answered the phones at seven in the morning, closed the books at month-end, written the proposals, and chased the invoices. They know where the manual work piles up in a business like yours because they have carried it.

 A senior leader who has run a business like yours leads your Evaluation — and stays accountable through the Install.

 The senior leadership team

### Straight answers.

#### Will it embarrass us in front of customers?
 Every agent says what it is in its first sentence, answers only from your data, books in under a minute, and hands to a person the moment someone asks. Before it speaks to a single customer, you approve its first hundred replies.

#### Will my people use it?
 Training is inside the Install. Nothing goes live until your staff can run it, and the first thing every person gets is a Chief of Staff agent — so the first thing the workforce does is give them their day back.

#### What does it cost against a hire?
 Far less than the person you would otherwise have hired — for far more than one person's work. You pay one firm one predictable price for a workforce that covers every department and works around the clock: no salary, no benefits, no recruiting, no turnover. The Evaluation ends with your number in writing.

#### Who do I call when it breaks?
 Us. One firm, one number. The Management stage exists for exactly this: we run it, update it, and answer the phone.

#### What do I get back?
 The Report — additional work completed, hours returned to the team, and how the business is performing — in your own figures, on the schedule set in the engagement.

#### Is this replacing my staff?
 No. Agents take the routine; people do the work only people can do. The business grows without hiring.

 All the answers · Ask our agent the one that is not here

## How it works — the Evaluation, the Install, Management, the Report | AI Native
URL: https://ainative.ai/how-it-works.html

How it works 
## Four stages. One accountable firm.
 We evaluate the business, install the workforce, manage it over time, and report what changed — in your numbers.

 1 
### The Evaluation
 A senior leader who has run a business like yours meets with you and your leadership — the owner, and whoever runs the office, the books, sales, and service. Department by department we map the work that is done by hand today: the phones, the leads, the proposals, the orders, the invoices, the reminders, the follow-up nobody gets to. We show you which of it an agent takes, which tools you keep, which we bring, and who checks it.
 What you leave with: the map of your manual work, the tools and the workforce we would install, the number, and the timeline — in writing.

 2 
### The Install
 First the tools, then the agents. We set up the tools you keep and bring the ones you are missing — website chat, a scheduling calendar, a bookkeeping system, a customer-service inbox — each one ready for an agent to work inside. Then we design the workforce for your company and for each person in it, configure every agent on your own data — your pricing, your policies, your voice — and train your staff to run all of it. Training is not a step after the Install; it is inside it.
 The rule: nothing is installed until your staff can run it. Before an agent speaks to a customer, you approve its first hundred replies.

 3 
### Management
 We run the workforce, update its configuration as your business changes, and support adoption — the second month is where most software fails and where our work starts. When something breaks, you call us. When an agent is unsure, it hands to a person and tells us.
 One number. One firm accountable for the whole workforce, not twelve vendors accountable for a login each.

 4 
### The Report
 On the schedule set in the engagement you see what changed: additional work completed, hours returned to the team and what they went to, and how the business is performing on the AI Native way of operating. Every figure is measured or labelled a target. Nothing is rounded to look better.
 What the Report shows 

### Agents need tools. We bring them.

 An agent works inside an application. Where you already have the right one, it stays. Where one is missing, we bring it — a scheduling calendar such as Calendly, a bookkeeping system such as QuickBooks, a customer-service inbox such as Gorgias, chat on your website — chosen for the outcome you want, licensed on your behalf or provided by AI Native, set up, and taught. It is in the plan and the price.

#### The tools you keep
 If you like your CRM, your phones, your store, they stay. The agents are tied into what you already use.

- Your CRM

- Your phone system

- Your store

- Your accounting

#### The tools we bring
 Where a tool is missing, we bring the best one for the job, ready for agents — licensed on your behalf, set up by us, and taught to your team.

- Website chat

- A scheduling calendar

- A bookkeeping system

- A customer-service inbox

#### The tools we make
 When nothing on the market fits, AI Native provides its own application or builds one for you. Same plan, same price, same firm.

- An AI Native application

- A custom application

 Decided in the Evaluation, priced in the plan, set up and trained by us. Nothing is added that the work does not need — and you never learn a tool alone.

### What the Evaluation is not.

#### Not a demo
 You will not watch a product. You will sit with a senior leader who has run a business like yours and go through your departments one at a time.

#### Not a sales pitch
 If the honest answer is that one department is worth doing and the rest are not, that is the answer you get. The map is yours either way.

#### Not a commitment
 The Evaluation ends with a written plan. The Install begins only when your leadership signs it.

### Who should be in the room.

 The owner, and the people who carry the manual work: the office manager, the controller or bookkeeper, whoever runs sales and service. An hour of their time in the Evaluation is what saves them the rest of the year.

#### Will it embarrass us in front of customers?
 Every agent says what it is in its first sentence, answers only from your data, books in under a minute, and hands to a person the moment someone asks. Before it speaks to a single customer, you approve its first hundred replies.

#### Will my people use it?
 Training is inside the Install. Nothing goes live until your staff can run it, and the first thing every person gets is a Chief of Staff agent — so the first thing the workforce does is give them their day back.

#### What does it cost against a hire?
 Far less than the person you would otherwise have hired — for far more than one person's work. You pay one firm one predictable price for a workforce that covers every department and works around the clock: no salary, no benefits, no recruiting, no turnover. The Evaluation ends with your number in writing.

#### Who do I call when it breaks?
 Us. One firm, one number. The Management stage exists for exactly this: we run it, update it, and answer the phone.

## Your AI workforce — a Chief of Staff agent for every worker, an agent for every job | AI Native
URL: https://ainative.ai/workforce.html

Your AI workforce 
## A Chief of Staff agent for every worker. An agent for every job that runs by hand.
 Designed for your company and for each person in it. Tied into the software you already use. Managed by one firm.

### The roster, by department.

#### Chief of Staff agent
 for every worker Handles communications and project assignments, triages and drafts email, keeps the calendar, writes meeting notes and follow-ups, and tracks status. Time on routine work becomes time on the projects only that person can do.

#### Sales agent
 sales Answers every lead in minutes, in writing and by voice, qualifies it, drafts the quote or proposal from your pricing and your past work, follows up until there is an answer, books the meeting, and keeps the CRM clean. A smaller, far more productive sales team.

#### Customer Service agent
 customer service Answers requests instantly and accurately across chat, email, and voice — inbound and outbound — tied into the CRM and the back office. Books, reschedules, answers order status, handles returns, requests and responds to reviews, and hands to a person the moment someone asks.

#### Bookkeeping agent
 finance, accounting, bookkeeping Runs AP and AR, invoicing, collections, expenses, and reconciliation; prepares payroll and sales tax; closes the month on time; and produces the KPI dashboard. Finance time moves from data entry to strategy.

#### Marketing agent
 marketing Drafts content and campaign creative, deploys ads, runs SEO and social, sends lifecycle email and SMS, manages reviews and reputation, tests creative at scale, and reports on all of it.

#### Operations agent
 operations Enters orders — including the ones that arrive as emailed POs — manages inventory and reorder points, handles purchasing and vendor communication, and keeps fulfillment and scheduling moving.

#### HR agent
 people Screens candidates, schedules interviews, prepares onboarding documents, tracks PTO, answers policy questions, and sends compliance reminders.

#### IT Helpdesk agent
 IT and legal Tier-1 helpdesk and access provisioning; first-pass contract review and renewal tracking, with anything material handed to a person.

 These are examples. The workforce covers every department you have, and every use — the Evaluation maps yours.

### Two kinds of work.

#### Work a person does today
 Moves to an agent that does it as well or better, and the person is freed for the work only a person can do. We measure the hours returned — and what they went to.

#### Work that never got done
 Because it needed a person you could not afford: chat that answers at 2 a.m. and writes the CRM, every account contacted for reorder, every dormant customer reactivated, every estimate followed up. Now it gets done.

### Every agent works inside a tool.

 The Customer Service agent answers inside your website chat and your customer-service inbox; the Bookkeeping agent works inside your bookkeeping system; the Sales agent books inside your calendar. If you have the tool, it stays. If you don't, we bring one that is ready for agents, set it up, and teach your team — part of the Install, inside the one price.

 The tools you keep, the tools we bring, the tools we make 

### How agents work with your people.

- Every agent says what it is in its first sentence, in chat and by voice.

- It hands to a person when asked, when it is unsure, and on any topic you list.

- You approve its first hundred replies before it speaks to a customer.

- It works inside your systems — the CRM, the books, the phones, the store — not beside them.

- Your people are trained to lead their agents; nothing goes live until they can.

- You see what it did, in the Report.

 How our agents identify themselves · Try ours 

### Map your workforce.
 The Evaluation goes through your departments one at a time and shows you which work an agent takes, what it is tied into, and who checks it.

 Book the Evaluation See how the Install works

### How it is counted.

- Work completed — calls answered, leads answered, quotes sent, invoices out, orders entered: counted from your systems, not estimated.

- Hours returned — the time the manual work took before, measured in the Evaluation, against the time it takes your people now; and what those hours went to.

 Measured, or labelled a target. Never rounded to look better. Never a percentage we have not measured. If a number is not there yet, the Report says so.

## Straight answers — what small business owners ask about AI agents | AI Native
URL: https://ainative.ai/answers.html

Straight answers 
## The questions owners ask before they sign. Answered in full sentences.

#### Will it embarrass us in front of customers?
 Every agent says what it is in its first sentence, answers only from your data, books in under a minute, and hands to a person the moment someone asks. Before it speaks to a single customer, you approve its first hundred replies.

#### Will my people use it?
 Training is inside the Install. Nothing goes live until your staff can run it, and the first thing every person gets is a Chief of Staff agent — so the first thing the workforce does is give them their day back.

#### What does it cost against a hire?
 Far less than the person you would otherwise have hired — for far more than one person's work. You pay one firm one predictable price for a workforce that covers every department and works around the clock: no salary, no benefits, no recruiting, no turnover. The Evaluation ends with your number in writing.

#### Who do I call when it breaks?
 Us. One firm, one number. The Management stage exists for exactly this: we run it, update it, and answer the phone.

#### What do I get back?
 The Report — additional work completed, hours returned to the team, and how the business is performing — in your own figures, on the schedule set in the engagement.

#### Is this replacing my staff?
 No. Agents take the routine; people do the work only people can do. The business grows without hiring.

#### What about our data?
 Agents work inside the systems you already use and are tied into them under the Install agreement. What stays where is written down before anything is installed.

#### We already tried a chatbot. We use ChatGPT.
 Those are tools and bolt-ons. This is a workforce for the whole company, with a firm accountable for it.

#### We're too small. Or too complicated.
 A solo operator gets the first staff they have ever had. A 300-person distributor gets an agent in every department. The Evaluation is where complicated gets mapped.

#### How long does it take?
 We give you the timeline in writing at the end of the Evaluation, and we do not install anything until your staff can run it.

#### Do we have to change our software?
 No. If you like your tools, you keep them; the agents are tied into what you already use. Where a tool is missing — chat on your site, a calendar, a bookkeeping system, a customer-service inbox — we bring one that is ready for agents, set it up, and train you.

#### We don't have much software. Is that a problem?
 No — it is the usual starting point. An agent needs a tool to work inside, so where one is missing we bring it. We choose it for the outcome you want, license it on your behalf or provide our own, set it up, and train you. It is in the plan and the price.

#### Will we have to buy a lot of software?
 No. You keep what works. We add only what the work needs, and it is inside the one price you see at the end of the Evaluation — not a stack of subscriptions for you to manage.

#### What happens if we stop?
 Management ends and the agents are retired from your systems. Nothing about your business is held hostage; the terms are in the agreement you sign before the Install.

#### Who will we be talking to?
 A senior leader from AI Native who has run a business like yours — not a salesperson, not a junior consultant. Our senior leadership team has built and run businesses of every kind and size together for 35 years, and the leader who maps your business stays accountable through the Install.

#### Who is accountable?
 AI Native. A senior leader leads the Evaluation, the firm does the Install, and the firm manages the workforce. You have one party to call, and it is us.

### The one that is not here.
 Ask our agent — it answers from the same rules, and hands you to a person the moment you ask.
 Ask our agent

 It is a conversation between operators.

About 
## Operators, not vendors.
 AI Native is the AI workforce firm. We design, install, train, and manage a complete AI agent workforce for every worker in every department of a small or medium-sized business — done for you, reported in your numbers. And we are led by people who have run businesses like yours.

### The senior leadership team.
 Thirty-five years of building and running businesses together — every kind, every size.

 Businesses that serve people in person. Businesses that sell products to people. Firms that serve other businesses, and companies that supply them. Startups and one-person operations; small companies and medium-sized ones with hundreds of people. Our senior leaders have started them, run them, grown them, and sold them — from the front desk to the back office, in sales, marketing, technology, product, operations, customer service, finance, accounting, and bookkeeping.

 They have answered the phones at seven in the morning and closed the books at month-end. They have written the proposal at ten at night and chased the invoice at the end of the quarter. They know where the manual work piles up in a business like yours because they have carried it — and they know, department by department, how to hand it to an agent workforce and run the company the AI Native way.

### A senior leader leads your Evaluation.
 Not a salesperson. Not a junior consultant.

 A senior leader from this team who has run a business like yours sits with you and your leadership, maps your departments, and writes the plan — the tools you keep, the tools we bring, the workforce, the number, and the timeline. The same leader stays accountable through the Install and the Management. You will never have to explain your business to someone who has not run one.

### How the firm behaves.

#### Operators first
 Every engagement opens with an operator's evaluation of the business, never a demo. We speak your language — missed calls, month-end close, speed-to-lead — never the AI industry's. We install nothing we would not run in our own company.

#### Done means done
 We own evaluation, design, configuration, setup, training, management, and reporting. Nothing counts as installed until your staff can run it. One accountable party, one number to call.

#### People do the human work
 Every agent is designed around a real worker in a real role. We measure work completed and hours returned — and what those hours went to. We sell growth without hiring, not headcount cuts.

#### Prove it
 Results in your own KPIs. No figure we have not measured; targets are labelled. Agents disclose that they are agents.

#### Calm
 Plain words, short sentences, no hype. We tell you what an agent cannot do. Nothing sounds urgent unless it is.

Our agents 
## How our agents identify themselves.
 If you have spoken with an agent that said “powered by AI Native,” this page is for you.

### What we promise the people our agents talk to.

- An AI Native agent says it is an AI agent in its first sentence, every conversation, in chat and by voice. It never pretends to be a person.

- Ask for a person and you get one. Say “person” in chat, or ask on the phone, and the agent steps back.

- It answers from the business's own information. When it is not sure, it says so and hands off.

- It confirms what it did — the booking, the order, the reply — in one plain sentence.

- It does not sell you things you did not ask about, and it does not keep you waiting to make a point.

 The owner, and the people who carry the manual work: the office manager, the controller or bookkeeper, whoever runs sales and service.
